messages:
mika-ops: Quick chase — Action items from the INC-2026-03 postmortem are showing as overdue. Specifically: KV-cache fallback + routing policy update assigned to @samir-sre, and the customer-facing runbook update assigned to @elaine-cust-eng. Can owners confirm status?

samir-sre: Sorry for the delay, been pulled onto a high-priority deploy. I have a draft PR for the KV-cache fallback but it's not ready for review yet. ETA Fri EOD for PR creation.

jordan-pm: We flagged timelines in the postmortem. These items are blockers for closure. Need owners + concrete dates so we can roll the postmortem to "complete."

samir-sre: Ack. Plan: finish PR, add a unit + integration test for the fallback, and coordinate with eng-platform for canary routing. New ETA: Tue 03/03 COB.

mika-ops: Please post the PR link in the postmortem and update the ticket when created. If anything slips again, tag me.

elaine-cust-eng: For the runbook edits I started notes but haven't published — will finish and link by Mon 03/02 noon PT. Will include steps for on-call investigation and customer comms.

incidents-bot: Reminder: INC-2026-03 has 2 unresolved action items (owners: samir-sre, elaine-cust-eng). Original due date 1768460000.

jordan-pm: Also raising a pattern concern — this is the third throttling incident in ~6 weeks. Can we get a short proposal (2–3 mitigations) so we can prioritize in next sprint?

samir-sre: Agreed. I'll draft a routing/burst-policy proposal and brief eng-platform + eng-sre. Expect a 1-pager and perf numbers by next Wed.

mika-ops: If we don't have PR + runbook by Tue EOD I'll escalate to Eng Managers. Please keep updates to the ticket and drop links here.

samir-sre: Understood. I'll update ticket with timelines and add a test plan. Will post PR link when I push.

elaine-cust-eng: I'll review samir's PR once available and add the runbook link. Leaving a :thumbsup: reaction once merged + tests pass.

mika-ops: Thanks — closing this chase for now. Re-open if any ETA misses.
